name: stitchu-pack

bash.why: Baseline gate: force-pushing main destroys shared history; RULES 9 pushes only clean, green states.
Baseline gate + RULES 9: a broken change is reverted via normal commits, not by rewriting shared branch state.
ENV.md Deploy: lowercase english commit messages, no co-author tags.
ENV.md Deploy: wrangler deploy is DAMLA'S step; the agent must never deploy or claim the worker is live.
CLAUDE.md + RULES.md: STRATEGY.md is never loaded into agent context (stale/contradictory strategy poisons the loop).
CLAUDE.md SEO: no hand-editing HTML — fix the generator (gen-*-pages.mjs) and regenerate everything.

protectedPaths.why: RULES 4: golden diff stays byte-identical when features are off; the golden is a reference, not a thing to edit into passing.
CLAUDE.md SEO: 'Elle HTML düzenleme YOK' — pages are produced by gen-pattern-pages.mjs / gen-collection-pattern.mjs / gen-style-pages.mjs; change the generator.
CLAUDE.md SEO: sitemap+robots are emitted by the page generators, not hand-maintained.
CLAUDE.md + RULES.md: STRATEGY.md is banned from agent context; an agent that cannot read it cannot legitimately write it.

notes: rules carry their own why; review before importing — a guard is law, not decoration
